newsitem.title: USA: Astoria to buy Greater NY Savings Bank.
newsitem.headline: Astoria to buy Greater NY Savings Bank.

text.p: Astoria Financial Corp said Monday it will acquire The Greater New York Savings Bank in a $293 million transaction.

Under terms of a definitive agreement, holders of Greater New York common stock will receive either 0.50 shares of Astoria Financial common stock or $19.00 in cash for each share, subject to 75 percent of The Greater New York shares receiving Astoria common stock and 25 percent receiving cash.

The companies said the outstanding shares of the 12 percent noncumulative Preferred Stock, Series B, of Greater New York will be converted into a newly-created series of preferred stock of Astoria Financial Corp with substantially identical, and no less favorable terms.

The transaction is expected to close in the latter part of the third quarter and will be immediately accretive to Astoria's reported and cash earnings per share. Astoria said it estimates that operating efficiencies as a result of the transaction will produce cost savings equal to 45 percent of Greater New York's non-interest expense.
The companies said the transaction will be accounted for as a purchase and will not affect Astoria's ability to repurchase shares under its current stock repurchase program.

The agreement includes a termination fee payable to Astoria if the transaction is not completed under certain circumstances. In addition, Greater New York has granted Astoria an option to purchase shares equal to 19.9 percent of Greater New York's currently outstanding common stock under certain conditions.
